# ValuationLab data recommendation
Verified against primary provider documentation on 2026-10-17. No account, key, subscription, purchase, or permission grant was created. Coverage claims below are documented capabilities, not successful entitlement tests for all 14 symbols.

## Recommendation
Use SEC filings and a server-side normalization cache as the free fundamentals backbone. Preserve original filings as immutable evidence. A free, complete, keyless, redistribution-cleared service covering every required valuation field and current prices for arbitrary tickers was not established. Ship source-backed financial snapshots with an explicitly missing or manually entered dated market price until a quote provider and suitable use rights are approved. “Public tickers” does not automatically mean this app may publicly redistribute vendor data.

For personal use after user setup, Alpha Vantage is a plausible free statement/quote supplement; Finnhub is a plausible free as-reported/quote supplement. Do not imply either has authenticated coverage of every required ticker. All vendor adapters should be optional and disabled without configuration. Do not fetch third-party prices through undocumented Yahoo endpoints or a public CORS proxy.

## Free sources
- SEC: no API key; submissions and companyfacts cover domestic and foreign filing forms. Companyfacts includes standard taxonomy, entity-wide facts, not every custom or dimensional disclosure. APIs update as filings arrive, but a company can remain months behind current economic conditions. No browser CORS. API reference:

## Implementation and accounting specification (engineering recommendation)
- Resolve symbols through SEC company_tickers.json and submissions metadata; key records by CIK + security identity, not ticker alone. Target AAPL, MSFT, AMZN, GOOG, META, NVDA, TSLA, COHR, LITE, AAOI, NBIS, MU, AVGO, TSM.
- Fundamentals GET:
text.2dff310a8d63aa8a2503:
ta.sec.gov/submissions/CIK##########.json. Preserve a filing's original accession, accepted timestamp and primary document. Use SEC original filing when standard tags are missing or ambiguous.
- Raw files are immutable, keyed by accession and checksum. Current/latest views are derived. Cache lookup lists 24 hours; check submissions periodically server-side and fetch companyfacts when filing history changes. Do not report a refresh as successful merely because an old cached response loaded.
- “As of” historical valuations must filter acceptance <= decision time before selecting facts. Later restatements/comparative numbers cannot enter a historical run. Current companyfacts alone is not a point-in-time database. Preserve original as-filed contexts, units and accession.
- Income/cash-flow duration facts require fiscal start/end matching. Never sum four YTD facts. Build discrete Q2/Q3 from same-year cumulative differences when appropriate, Q4 = FY minus 9M; TTM = four nonoverlapping quarters or FY + current YTD - prior-year comparable YTD. Store component references and formula. Balance sheets use latest instant, never a sum.
- Companyfacts frames are not sufficient to infer issuer fiscal quarters. Different issuers have noncalendar and 52/53-week fiscal years. Fiscal year labels can differ from year in period-end dates.
- Do not fabricate EBITDA, capex, debt, working capital or tax rates when a concept is missing. Define cash versus short-term investments, gross debt versus net debt, and treatment of lease liabilities explicitly. Null means unavailable; reported zero is zero. Store source tags and all adjustments.
- Use current outstanding economic shares for current per-share equity value; weighted-average diluted shares are a different accounting measure. Preserve both and distinguish class-level from issuer-total shares. Alphabet and Meta need class-aware identity. Compare price and share basis after splits without double adjustment.
- TSM requires reporting-currency versus USD ADR price reconciliation and a verified depositary ratio. Never simply divide TWD equity value by ADR count or ordinary-share value by ADR price. NBIS requires checking latest issuer form/taxonomy and continuing-operation comparability after its restructuring. Do not assume foreign private issuers have quarterly 10-Q data; obtain issuer releases/6-K as needed, or label annual-only.
- A vendor-normalized quarterly response may not guarantee point-in-time history. Check filing dates and original source, preserve missing values and provider adjustments. EODHD documents yearly/quarterly Financials and filing_date, currency_symbol and shares history, but this is not proof of historical vintage integrity:

l-apis/stock-etfs-fundamental-data-feeds

## UI/contract requirements
Use /api/companies?query= and /api/company/:symbol?asOf=... on an owned backend, or a prebuilt static cache clearly labeled snapshot. Browser never receives provider secrets. Validate symbols server-side; no open arbitrary-URL proxy. Provider-specific CORS not established except SEC's explicit no-CORS; backend avoids that dependency and controls licensing/cache policy.

Each numeric field: value (number|null), unit/currency, periodStart, periodEnd, periodType (FY/Q/TTM/instant), filedAt, acceptedAt, accession, form, sourceUrl, sourceTag, status (reported/derived/missing/conflict), derivation and components. Identity: symbol, cik, exchange, securityType, reportingCurrency, quoteCurrency, shareClass, ordinarySharesPerDepositaryShare and verification source.

Separate quote.priceAsOf from financial periodEnd and from fetchedAt. Include lastSuccessfulRefreshAt, latestFilingCheckedAt, nextCheckAt, cacheAge, provider, providerLicenseMode, status and missingFields. Quote: price nullable, raw/adjusted basis, currency, timestamp, delay, source URL. Never label old snapshots live or current simply because fetched today.

Quality flags: annual_only, ttm_incomplete, quote_missing, quote_stale, currency_conversion_missing, adr_ratio_unverified, share_basis_unverified, custom_tag_review, source_conflict, upstream_unavailable. Block misleading per-share/market-upside outputs when quote, FX, ADR ratio or denominator cannot be reconciled. Forecast assumptions remain visibly user assumptions, not fetched facts.
